meta.name: Sejarah Berdirinya GMNI (GmniHistoryShort)
meta.mood: khidmat, historis, hangat sinematik dokumenter 1950-an — senja plum-indigo berpadu cahaya emas tungsten & aksen Merah Putih
meta.styleReference: Twilight Parchment Documentary style (twilight-parchment-docu) adapted from Earth 24 Hours & HumanFireShort — zero clock dial, 100% pure code + user-provided official GMNI emblem.

palette.usage: 60% deep plum/indigo shadows & atmospheric midtones, 25% archival silhouettes, 15% warm tungsten gold & Merah Putih crimson highlights. Zero #000 or #fff.

dominantSources: S1: Warm 1950s golden twilight sun over Jakarta colonial skyline
S2: Glowing archival map table light & converging crimson-gold fusion beams
S3: Warm tungsten pendant lamps inside Gedung Proklamasi & Taman Suropati
S4: Golden morning sunrise over 1954 Surabaya & glowing Congress hall stage
S5: Heroic warm podium backlight behind Bung Karno & glowing Merah Putih dawn
S6: Expanding archipelago pin lights -> radiant golden emblem halo behind GMNI shield
light.rimLighting: Every 1950s human silhouette, colonial building, and landmark renders warm tungsten/crimson rim highlights facing the active light origin.
light.castShadows: Dynamic soft ground shadows pointing strictly away from key light.

typography.subtitleCard: Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif (deckle-edge parchment card, centered safe zone)
